stages.description: Awake at home. Questioned by your partner Elora about last night's secret call to the keep.
Retrieve your service blade from the footlocker and step out into Oakhaven Village.
Investigate the village disturbance and speak with Blacksmith Brand to obtain the Garrison Side Key.
Breach the Royal Garrison Keep and defeat the corrupted skirmishers in the lower barracks.
Confront Captain Malakor in the War Room, defeat his corrupted form, and seal the Azrath vault breach.
